svg.text: R / R₀ = C₀(β) + C₁(β)(β / θ) + C₂(β)(β / θ)²
Schematic: H / E / W controls, rays and candidate shoreline
IMPORTANT • Planform geometry alone does not establish zero sediment transport.
Same quadratic formula; different empirical coefficients.
A close geometric fit is not proof of static equilibrium.
Interpret the shoreline with wave climate, sediment budgets, coastal controls,
observed shoreline position and the time scale of sediment exchange.
